newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chiron plans March launch of blood analyser.
newsitem.headline: Chiron plans March launch of blood analyser.

text.p: Chiron Diagnostics will begin the world-wide roll-out of its Rapidpoint 400 blood analysis system on March 18 in Brussels, its public relations company said in a statement.
The company said the Rapidpoint 400 Integrated Critical Care Diagnostic System would be the "first rapid, fully automated, maintenance-free whole blood analysis system".
Chiron Diagnostics president Richard Barker is scheduled to present details of the product, which would provide blood tests within 60 seconds or less at the point of care, the company said.
